statusNote: Runs three full-time terms a year (Spring, Summer, Fall).
summary: The Linux Foundation Mentorship Program (LFX Mentorship) pairs mentees with mentors from Linux Foundation projects such as CNCF projects. Mentees learn open source collaboration while contributing to a real project.

stipend.detail: Based on your country of current residence, using Purchasing Power Parity (PPP): a base of $6,000 adjusted per country, with a minimum of $1,000 and a maximum of $6,600. Amounts apply to programs starting on or after July 1, 2026.
stipend.method: Mentees submit an Expensify report after each successful evaluation; international payments go by wire transfer and can take up to six weeks to arrive.
stipend.tableNote: Total stipend for your country of residence.

facts.label: Full-time terms
facts.value: Spring: Mar 1 – May 31 · Summer: Jun 1 – Aug 31 · Fall: Sep 1 – Nov 30

facts.label: Evaluations
facts.value: Every 3 weeks (full-time); midterm and final are required

facts.label: Completion
facts.value: Digital Letter of Completion after meeting all requirements

eligibility: At least 18 years old when the program starts.
Not a prior or active participant in another Linux Foundation mentorship program.
Eligible to work in the country where you will participate.
Not living in a country where participation is prohibited under U.S. or other applicable law.
Applying for yourself, with no obligations (such as an employment contract) that prevent participation.
Meet the prerequisites set by the program you apply to.

timeline.label: Review and acceptance
timeline.date: About 2 weeks before the term begins

howToApply: Create a mentee profile on LFX Mentorship with your Linux Foundation account.
Apply to the mentorship programs you are interested in.
Complete every prerequisite task during the review period; applications without them are not accepted.
Selected mentees are notified and complete a contract and onboarding.
